jobs.title: Principal, IT Strategy & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.
The Role

The Principal, IT Strategy & Operations Manager is a senior individual-contributor role that partners with Technology VPs, Finance, business leaders, and external partners to shape IT strategy, translate technology investments into business value, and drive disciplined execution. The role combines strategic planning with hands-on ownership of cloud program financial operations, budgeting, forecasting, governance, and executive reporting.

Location

This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

- IT strategy and business value: Partner with VPs to define transformation priorities, future-state capabilities, roadmaps, and investment choices. Identify how IT can improve customer outcomes, operational performance, and top-line growth, and translate recommendations into clear business cases and measurable outcomes.
- AI and operational efficiency:  Identify and advance practical AI, automation, analytics, and process-improvement opportunities that reduce manual effort, improve decision quality, and increase productivity across the organization.
- Financial planning and governance:  Manage cloud-program budgets, forecasts, milestones, funding requests, business cases, and actuals. Maintain alignment with Lumen Transformation Office, Finance, corporate planning, and Long-Term Outlook requirements, and provide clear variance explanations and decision support.
- Professional services and forecasting:  Coordinate professional-services funding requests and governance reviews, guide teams through procurement, maintain contract-level capital and expense forecasts, post monthly actuals, and prepare reporting for Cloud Program leadership.
- Executive & Organizational Operations:  Maintain dashboards, scorecards, leadership decks, and portfolio reporting.
- Lead cross-functional follow-through on priorities, risks, dependencies, and actions while continuously improving financial controls and operating processes.
- Cloud budget management a s needed by providing support on monthly accruals; reconcile cloud-management data, provider invoices, actuals, and minimum commitments; maintain commitment-attainment reporting; validate dashboards; and provide detailed cloud-spend analysis across AWS, Microsoft, and Google.

What We Look For in a Candidate

- 1 2 + years of progressive experience in IT strategy, technology finance, business operations, consulting, transformation, or related disciplines.
- Bachelor's degree in Business , Finance, Technology, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
- Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, accruals, variance analysis, business cases, capital and expense management,  accounting, and investment governance.
- Strong knowledge of cloud economics, FinOps, cloud-provider billing, professional-services spend, procurement, invoicing, and commitment management.
- Ability to connect technology strategy to business outcomes, operational efficiency, customer value, and revenue impact.
- Experience influencing senior leaders and coordinating work across Technology, Finance, Procurement, Accounts Payable, vendors, and business teams.
- Strong analytical, communication,  executive-presentation , and problem-solving skills; experience with dashboards, reporting, AI, and automation.

Compensation

This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

jobs.title: Director, Chief of Staff - Enterprise Finance Planning
jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.
The Role

The Director, Chief of Staff serves as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to the SVP, Enterprise Finance Planning, helping translate strategic priorities into enterprise execution.
This role acts as an extension of the SVP and operates at the center of Finance, Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, and Corporate Functions to drive alignment, accountability, governance, and business outcomes across the organization's most critical initiatives.Unlike traditional Chief of Staff roles focused primarily on communications or administrative coordination, this position is responsible for driving enterprise-wide transformation efforts, improving business processes, establishing governance frameworks, facilitating cross-functional decision-making, and ensuring strategic initiatives achieve measurable results.

The ideal candidate thrives in highly ambiguous, fast-paced environments and has a demonstrated ability to influence across executive teams, build scalable operating mechanisms, and lead complex initiatives where success depends on coordination across multiple organizations.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Partnership & Executive Advisory
Serve as a trusted advisor to the SVP Enterprise Finance Planning on strategic priorities, organizational challenges, and enterprise
initiatives.
Help translate business objectives into actionable plans with clear accountability and measurable outcomes.
Provide independent perspectives and challenge assumptions to improve decision quality.
Support executive decision-making through structured problem solving, business case development, and strategic analysis.
Act as an extension of leadership in cross-functional forums, driving alignment and execution across the organization.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Enterprise Execution
Lead strategic initiatives that span Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Finance, and Corporate Functions.
Act as the central integration point across stakeholders to drive clarity, alignment, and execution.
Facilitate decisions across organizations where responsibilities, priorities, or objectives may converge.
Drive accountability and follow-through on key enterprise commitments and strategic initiatives.
Identify risks, dependencies, and execution barriers and proactively drive resolution.

Business Transformation & Process Excellence
Lead initiatives focused on simplification, operational efficiency, and scalable business processes.
Drive process redesign efforts across functions to eliminate inefficiencies, reduce friction, and improve organizational effectiveness.
Establish sustainable operating mechanisms that improve consistency, speed, accountability, and business outcomes.
Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and modernization of business processes.
Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance organizational performance and execution.

Governance, Policy & Operating Model Development
Lead development and implementation of governance frameworks, decision-making models, and operating principles supporting strategic initiatives.
Design and maintain business policies, operating procedures, and accountability frameworks that improve enterprise execution.
Create clear ownership structures, escalation paths, and decision rights for complex initiatives.
Partner with business leaders to ensure governance processes enable execution without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
Drive consistency and transparency across enterprise planning and execution processes.

Digital Business & Business Model Transformation
Support enterprise initiatives related to digital products, SaaS offerings, platform-based solutions, and consumption-driven business models.
Partner with business leaders to evaluate the organizational impacts of new business models and operating approaches.
Establish decision frameworks and governance processes that support digital growth and transformation.
Drive cross-functional readiness and execution for strategic growth initiatives.
Facilitate alignment between business strategy, operational execution, and organizational capabilities.

Executive Communications & Leadership Engagement
Develop executive presentations, strategic narratives, Board-ready materials, business cases, and leadership communications.
Translate complex business issues into concise, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
Facilitate executive workshops, strategy sessions, and leadership discussions.
Ensure alignment of messaging, priorities, and actions across senior stakeholders.
Support organizational communications related to transformation initiatives, governance changes, and strategic priorities.

What We Look For in a Candidate

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Technology, or related field.
8+ years of experience in strategy, transformation, consulting, business operations, business management, program leadership, or Chief of Staff roles.
- Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional initiatives in large matrixed organizations.
- Strong understanding of business operations, organizational effectiveness, and enterprise governance.
- Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders without direct authority.
- Exceptional problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.
- Outstanding written, verbal, and executive communication skills.
- Experience operating effectively within high-growth, high-change, and highly ambiguous environments.
- Strong executive presence and the ability to build credibility across multiple levels of leadership.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience within telecommunications, technology, cloud, SaaS, infrastructure, digital, or platform-based businesses.
- Experience supporting enterprise transformation, operating model modernization, or strategic change initiatives.
- Consulting experience from a top-tier strategy or transformation firm preferred.
- Experience developing governance frameworks, business policies, and enterprise operating models.
- Demonstrated success leading business process improvement and organizational effectiveness initiatives.
- MBA or equivalent combination of education and relevant business leadership experience.

jobs.title: Senior Investment Analyst
jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.
The Role

CenturyLink Investment Management (CIM) serves as the investment fiduciary for Lumen Technologies’ employee benefit assets, overseeing approximately $12 billion across pension and 401(k) trusts. We are seeking a Senior Investment Analyst to help shape investment strategy, asset allocation, portfolio construction, and investment manager selection for Lumen’s retirement plans.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an early-career investment professional to gain broad exposure across public and private markets while contributing to a lean, collaborative investment team. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with intellectual curiosity and a passion for financial markets, portfolio construction, and long-term investing.

Work Location

The Investment Management Team is Denver-based with a strong preference for a candidate located in the Denver metro area; however, highly-qualified remote candidates located in the U.S. will be considered.

The Main Responsibilities

- Conduct quantitative and qualitative research to generate market insights and support investment decision-making
- Analyze a broad range of investment strategies and asset classes to inform portfolio construction and asset allocation decisions
- Assist in the development and maintenance of capital market assumptions, portfolio analytics, and optimization models
- Evaluate portfolio positioning, performance attribution, risk exposures, and investment outcomes across strategies
- Participate in investment discussions by providing thoughtful analysis, challenging assumptions, and contributing new ideas
- Research trends, innovations, and best practices in defined contribution investing, retirement solutions, and institutional asset management
- Support due diligence and monitoring of external investment managers across public and private markets
- Leverage technology, data analytics, and artificial intelligence tools to enhance research processes and investment insights

What We Look For in a Candidate

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics, or a related field
- 3 to 10 years of experience in institutional investing, asset management, investment consulting, or a related field
- Strong foundation in investment, finance, economic, and capital market concepts
- Demonstrated analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving capabilities
- Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex information clearly
- Commitment to fiduciary responsibility, consistently acting with care, loyalty, and prudence in the best interests of plan participants
- Proficiency with Excel and investment research platforms such as Bloomberg, Morningstar, eVestment, or similar tools
- Strong attention to detail and ability to balance detailed analysis with portfolio-level thinking
- Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and professional development
- Curiosity about financial markets and a passion for investing
- Interest in leveraging emerging technologies, including AI, to improve investment research and decision-making

Preferred
- CFA designation or active progress toward earning the CFA charter
- Experience supporting asset allocation, portfolio construction, and manager research for an institutional fund
- Knowledge of performance attribution, risk management frameworks, and portfolio analytics
- Experience presenting investment recommendations to internal stakeholders
- Exposure to both public and private market investment strategies
- Ability to thrive in a collaborative, high-impact team environment

Compensation

jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.
The Role

Lumen is seeking a strategic, forward-thinking Senior Director of Finance to serve as the CFO and trusted business partner for our Product & Technology organization. This executive-level leader will provide financial leadership across a dynamic portfolio of digital, software, platform, cloud, and technology investments, helping shape decisions that accelerate growth, enhance profitability, and maximize shareholder value.

In this highly visible role, you will partner directly with executive leadership to drive financial strategy, long-range planning, investment prioritization, and business performance. You will lead a high-performing finance organization while influencing critical decisions related to product innovation, technology investments, resource allocation, and long-term growth.

Responsibilities

- Serve as the strategic finance leader and key business partner to Product & Technology leadership, translating business priorities into actionable financial strategies.
- Lead financial management across a complex portfolio, including revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, headcount planning, capital investments, EBITDA, and free cash flow.
- Drive annual planning, long-range planning, forecasting, and scenario analysis to support business growth and investment decisions.
- Partner with Product, Engineering, Technology, Sales, Marketing, and Corporate Strategy leaders to align financial plans with business objectives.
- Provide executive-level insights and recommendations regarding portfolio prioritization, organizational investments, profitability, and operational performance.
- Establish and govern key SaaS and digital business metrics, including recurring revenue, retention, customer economics, and product profitability.
- Evaluate strategic investments, product initiatives, acquisitions, and technology programs, ensuring disciplined capital allocation and measurable returns.
- Lead, develop, and inspire a world-class Product Finance organization focused on strategic decision support, business partnership, and financial excellence.

Qualifications

Minimum
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
- 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in Finance, FP&A, Corporate Finance, Business Finance, or Product Finance.
- Experience supporting SaaS, software, cloud, digital platform, or technology-driven businesses.
- Demonstrated success leading complex P&Ls and driving business performance in large, matrixed organizations.
- Experience partnering with executive leadership teams on strategic planning, investment decisions, and financial performance management.
- Deep understanding of SaaS business models, subscription and consumption economics, product development lifecycles, and software investment strategies.
- Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing finance teams and future leaders.
- Exceptional financial acumen, executive presence, communication, and influencing skills.

Preferred
- MBA, CPA, CFA, or other advanced business or finance credentials.
- Experience serving as a Finance Leader, CFO, or senior finance executive within a SaaS, cloud, enterprise software, or high-growth technology environment.
- Experience supporting Product, Engineering, or Technology organizations at scale.
- Knowledge of software capitalization, cloud infrastructure economics, hosting and delivery models, and digital business performance metrics.
- Experience evaluating mergers, acquisitions, integrations, or large-scale digital transformation initiatives.
- Background in telecommunications, cloud networking, digital platforms, AI infrastructure, or related technology sectors.
- Proven track record influencing outcomes across complex organizations without direct authority.
- Demonstrated ability to balance growth investments with disciplined financial management and value creation.
